rows.note: Use 爺爺 as the all-purpose everyday term for a paternal grandfather.

example.english: My grandfather often takes me for dim sum.
example.traditional: 我爺爺成日帶我去飲茶。
example.jyutping: ngo5 je4 je4 seng4 jat6 daai3 ngo5 heoi3 jam2 caa4

rows.note: Use 外公 for a maternal grandfather, on the mother's side.

example.english: My grandfather used to live in Sha Tin.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ngoi6 gung1 ji5 cin4 zyu6 hai2 saa1 tin4
